description: This is a Java test source file for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the enabling and configuration of dictionaries within the keyboard input method. It includes setup for user dictionaries, various input type scenarios, and interactions with suggestion and dictionary management components.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardDictionaryEnablingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying dictionary enabling, configuration, and behavior in the AnySoftKeyboard input method, including handling of different input types and user preferences.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a user dictionary with predefined words for testing.

methods.name: testDictionariesCreatedForText
methods.description: Verifies that dictionaries are created and suggestions are setup when input view is created.

methods.name: testDictionariesNotCreatedForTextWithOutViewCreated
methods.description: Ensures dictionaries are not created if the input view is not created.

methods.name: testDictionariesNotCreatedForPassword
methods.description: Checks that dictionaries are not created for password input types.

methods.name: testDictionariesNotCreatedForVisiblePassword
methods.description: Checks that dictionaries are not created for visible password input types.

methods.name: testDictionariesNotCreatedForWebPassword
methods.description: Checks that dictionaries are not created for web password input types.

methods.name: testDictionariesCreatedForUriInputButWithoutAutoPick
methods.description: Verifies dictionaries are created for URI input types without auto-pick.

methods.name: testDictionariesCreatedForEmailInputButNotAutoPick
methods.description: Verifies dictionaries are created for email input types without auto-pick.

methods.name: testDictionariesCreatedForWebEmailInputButNotAutoPick
methods.description: Verifies dictionaries are created for web email input types without auto-pick.

methods.name: testDictionariesCreatedForAutoComplete
methods.description: Checks that dictionaries are created when auto-complete is enabled.

methods.name: testDictionariesNotCreatedForNoSuggestions
methods.description: Ensures dictionaries are not created when no suggestions are requested.

methods.name: testDictionariesResetForPassword
methods.description: Verifies that dictionaries are reset when switching to password input types.

methods.name: testReleasingAllDictionariesIfPrefsSetToNoSuggestions
methods.description: Tests that all dictionaries are released when user preferences disable suggestions.

methods.name: testDoesNotCloseDictionaryIfInputRestartsQuickly
methods.description: Ensures dictionaries are not closed if input restarts within a short interval.

methods.name: testDoesCloseDictionaryIfInputRestartsSlowly
methods.description: Verifies dictionaries are closed if input restarts after a delay.

methods.name: testSettingCorrectModeFromPrefs
methods.description: Checks that correction mode is set according to user preferences.

methods.name: testSetDictionaryOnOverridePrefs
methods.description: Verifies that dictionary override preferences are correctly applied.

methods.name: testNotSetDictionaryOnNonOverridePrefs
methods.description: Ensures that non-override preferences do not trigger dictionary setup.
